q1_issues.issue: (Possession sk_charges_1 sec) — presupposed material identifying the definite 'the SEC charges' — sits only inside the strength-0.0 bundles (repeated identically at statements 7-10) and is never asserted outside them, against the projection rule that keeps a definite participant's presupposed atoms out of the denial.

q2_gaps: a proper-noun modifier on a common noun ('the SEC charges') — the compound-concepts rules explicitly do not apply to proper nouns and the possessive rules require 's, a possessive pronoun or an of-phrase, so no attachment head is licensed for this pattern

a sentence-initial frame adverbial scoping over the whole statement ('For legal purposes, ...') — only event-level obliques exist, so it can only be attached to the event and thereby falls inside the strength-0 denial, reading as part of what is denied
notes: 'Neither ... nor' correctly yields one strength-0 fact per disjunct, distributed over the coordinated subject into four bundles, and the simple present correctly carries no tense atom. Definite plurals 'the charges' / 'the settlements' take group witnesses as required, and the charges group is projected outside the denial.
